sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, absolute x/y centroid, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/celebrity/celebrity-millennium/v2432/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape element (rect/polygon/path, each carrying data-cabin) per stateroom. Rect centroids from x+w/2,y+h/2; polygon centroids from mean of points; path centroids computed by fully resolving relative SVG path commands to absolute anchor points and averaging. Category legend built by matching each fill colour to a Celebrity stateroom category using the fleet-wide Celebrity colour convention (identical palette verified against the Celebrity Edge deck SVGs from the same site) and cross-checked against cruisedeckplans.com Celebrity-Millennium per-category counts. Colour-to-category counts match cruisedeckplans on Interior (222 vs 229), Ocean View (251 vs 244), Deluxe Veranda (308 vs 309) and exactly on Celebrity Suite (8), Royal Suite (8) and Penthouse Suite (2).

notes.completeness: FULL grid of every numbered stateroom deckmaps encodes for Celebrity Millennium: decks 2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11. 1106 unique stateroom numbers, zero duplicates. deckmaps advertised per-deck counts (deck7=209) match the parse exactly. deckmaps' 1106 is slightly above Celebrity's often-cited ~1,079 staterooms; cruisedeckplans.com lists 1,216 for the same ship, but that total is inflated (its Concierge-Class row alone lists 265 vs the 135 cabins deckmaps colours as Concierge, accounting for almost the entire gap). No cabin number was invented; every number and position comes straight from the deckmaps SVGs. Decks 1,4,5,12 carry no numbered staterooms in the source (crew/public/Retreat sun deck).
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 21 distinct fills map to 10 Celebrity Millennium categories (most categories use several colour shades for sub-blocks / service tiers). See colorLegend. Concierge Class and AquaClass are physically veranda/ocean-view cabins sold as higher service tiers; they are reported as their sold (colour-coded) category. cruisedeckplans reports a higher Concierge count (265) than the 135 cabins deckmaps colours purple; the colour-coded value is used here. Deluxe Ocean View with Veranda absorbs the few Family-Veranda cabins (deckmaps gives them no distinct colour).
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Bow confirmed at the low-y end on every deck (cabin sequence numbers increase fore->aft). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of the ship length, using a single global y-range shared by the full-length decks 6-9 so partial decks (10 forward, 11 aft) are classified consistently. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED then ANCHORED to the Celebrity numbering convention. Even cabin numbers sit on the higher-x beam row and odd on the lower-x row, cleanly on every deck; with the bow at low y (viewed from above, bow up) higher x is starboard, so side = starboard for even numbers, port for odd - the same convention verified on Celebrity Edge (cabin 6218 even = starboard). No Millennium-specific first-person anchor was found, so this could be uniformly mirrored; validate against a known cabin before relying on it. Deck 10 (nums 1000-1024, all even, single column) is therefore all 'starboard' by parity - treat that deck's side with extra caution.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; NOT an assertion of guaranteed clear view). Celebrity Millennium does have some obstructed / lifeboat-view cabins - a separate research layer.
